# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest released version of Rogue Lab and the current development branch. Older releases do not receive separate security backports. This community-maintained project does not guarantee a response or fix deadline.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/BoyanGeorgiev96/btd6-rogue-calculator/security/advisories/new) on the feedback repository. Do not post vulnerability details, exploit files, or sensitive data in public issues or pull requests.

Include the affected version or commit, reproduction steps, expected impact, and a minimal example if possible. Remove personal information, credentials, and unrelated saved builds. Please allow time to investigate and coordinate a fix before publishing details.

If private reporting is unavailable, open an issue asking Boyan Georgiev for a private security contact, without including vulnerability details.

Calculation errors, outdated game data, and unsupported mechanics belong in ordinary [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BoyanGeorgiev96/btd6-rogue-calculator/issues) unless they also create a security vulnerability.
